headword: {予約|よやく}{注文|ちゅうもん}

definitions.explanation: An order placed before a product is released or available, securing the item for future delivery.

examples.japanese: {予約|よやく}{注文|ちゅうもん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{付|つ}けています→受け付ける：05683_uketsukeru⟧。
⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{予約|よやく}{注文|ちゅうもん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{予約|よやく}{注文|ちゅうもん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{発売日|はつばいび}→発売日：10160_hatsubaibi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: If you pre-order, it arrives on the release date.

notes:
{予約|よやく}{注文|ちゅうもん} is common for games, books, limited edition items, and products with high demand. Pre-ordering often comes with bonuses or guarantees availability.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予約|よやく}{注文|ちゅうもん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to place a pre-order)
